user.title: Set up Alexa Smart Home Manager
user.description: Enter the Client ID and Client secret of your Alexa Smart Home skill. You find them in the Alexa Developer Console under Build → Permissions → Alexa Skill Messaging, not under Account Linking.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Alexa Smart Home Manager
reconfigure.description: Change the event gateway or the Alexa Skill Messaging credentials. Exposed entities and names are kept. If you switch to a different skill, link it again in the Alexa app.

custom_endpoint.title: Custom event gateway
custom_endpoint.description: Enter the full URL of the Alexa event gateway.

error.invalid_client_id: The client ID does not have the expected format (should start with 'amzn1.application-oa2-client.').
error.invalid_client_secret: The client secret does not have the expected format (should start with 'amzn1.oa2-cs.v1.').
error.invalid_endpoint: The endpoint URL must start with https://.

abort.already_configured: This Alexa skill connection is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Alexa Smart Home Manager instance is supported.

init.title: Choose exposed entities
init.description: Search and pick every entity Alexa should see. You can filter by name, area or domain. Nothing is saved until you submit.

names.title: Alexa names (page {page}/{total_pages})
names.description:
Optionally give an entity a different name for Alexa. Leave a field empty to use its Home Assistant name. Submitting the last page saves everything.

{entities}

error.duplicate_names: Alexa cannot tell entities with the same name apart. Give them different names: {duplicates}

smart_home_conflict.title: Alexa Smart Home endpoint already in use
smart_home_conflict.description: Home Assistant already has an `alexa: smart_home:` block in configuration.yaml, which claims the endpoint this integration needs. Remove that block (other `alexa:` sections such as `flash_briefings` can stay) and restart Home Assistant.

missing_entities.title: Entities exposed to Alexa no longer exist

confirm.title: Stop exposing missing entities?
confirm.description:
These entities no longer exist in Home Assistant: {entities}

Select Submit to remove them from the entities exposed to Alexa. Alexa is told to forget them.

missing_entities.description:
These entities are exposed to Alexa but no longer exist in Home Assistant: {entities}

If you only renamed one, expose its new ID under Configure.
